title: Burgundy Velvet Jacket & Lace Jabot
prompt: An original young woman with long, straight dark hair stands in a cemetery with blurred headstones behind her. She wears a deep red velvet fitted jacket with a black lace jabot, a black velvet high collar, and a wide black belt. A gold cross pendant and a gold drop earring complete the look. Her lips are a bold red. Her expression is calm and serious, looking off to the side. Soft, natural daylight. Palette of burgundy, black, and aged gold. Dramatic and Victorian, in the style of a gothic period portrait.
workingNotes:
- The lace jabot and red velvet are the key contrasts.
- Keep the cemetery for a gothic, atmospheric setting.
